principles: Branch context, priority work and authoritative financial states lead the hierarchy; the experience is a checker command centre rather than generic CRUD.
Server-owned amounts remain currency-separated and use compact summary-to-detail composition without browser-recomputed totals.
Maker/checker, validation-before-receipt, external-refund and payout separation are stated next to the affected workflows.
Sensitive references stay masked and duplicate override requires the shipped permission, fresh step-up, explicit reason and idempotent server action.
Gate W and Phase 21N destinations remain discoverable but inert and dependency-specific; no Wallet, report or notification truth is fabricated.
The seven Finance groups follow the binding order in the left navigation across responsive surfaces.
outcome: accepted for UI-12 implementation evidence; UI-16 retains final cross-account visual-release authority
